legacy_identity: Canonical reconstructed exploratory 491199-case eight-cell dataset; not recovered original, not proven equivalent, not a verified correction or superset of the lost 410953-case run.

freeze.branching: Minimum domain; maximum residual active-factor degree; lowest CellId; values air,bottom,top. Existing fixed_hit shape-variable eligibility and component traversal stay unchanged.
freeze.build: GCC C++20, -std=c++20 -O3 -DNDEBUG; no PGO, LTO, -march=native or fast-math. Freeze compiler version/binary, build command and host before timing, unchanged across volumes/configurations.
freeze.new_collector_requirements: Variable-length per-cell state/domain arrays, no eight-cell packed unsigned masks; exact input serialization; independent references; external budget guards. Do not alter the old collector or evidence.

deferred_stress.substantial_failure_rule: At least 10 percent unresolved projections in the extension's predeclared moderate-visibility both-mode operating cohort triggers architecture review; define population and cost before any 27-cell call.

determinism.H: Unsigned big-endian integer digest of ASCII JSON array [master_seed,label,...arguments], compact separators comma/colon, no whitespace/newline; strings restricted to ASCII, integers decimal, no floats. Rank ascending by (H,CellId); non-cell ranks break ties by canonical ID.

mask_orders.compact: Anchor minimizes H('mask_anchor',geometry_id,cell). Breadth-first traversal of six face-neighbors inside the grid, neighbors ascending CellId, enqueue once. Prefix k is connected.
mask_orders.spread: Same anchor as compact. Repeatedly choose unselected cell maximizing its minimum Manhattan distance to selected cells; ties choose smallest CellId. Use prefixes; this is greedy spread, not an optimal-dispersion claim.

determinism.endpoint_rule: k=0 empty mask, k=N full mask, one recipe each. Equal masks from intermediate recipes remain separate design slots; never replace collisions.
determinism.occupancy_rank: Sort cells by H('occupancy',geometry_id,draw_index,cell). Reuse this order for all densities, k, recipes, palettes, views and resolutions.
determinism.latent_top_bit: H('shape',geometry_id,draw_index,cell) modulo 2; reuse across density, k, recipe, palette, view and resolution.
determinism.query_cells: First two cells ordered by H('query_cell',geometry_or_structured_case_id,cell); structured_case_id excludes palette and factor order. Reuse across configurations and epochs.
determinism.case_id: Use the ID arrays below as nested JSON values in hash arguments, not JSON-encoded strings. Store full case ID as compact ASCII JSON of [slot_id,palette]; palette uses split_material or same_material. Membership aliases are not part of IDs. Epoch indices are 0..4. Never encode outcomes in IDs.

slot_ids.camera_and_robustness: [category,geometry_id,k,mask_recipe,density_id,draw,actual_R,suite_id]; category is camera, restricted or contradictory. Only actual_R occurs, never regime aliases.
slot_ids.query_identity: Camera/robustness: geometry_id string; structured: [N,recipe_id,permutation_id] array; anchor: fixture_name string

determinism.job_ids: Camera/robustness: [category,geometry_id,actual_R,suite_id]; structured: ["structured",N,recipe_id]; anchors: ["anchor",8]. Within each volume/epoch, hash these arrays as nested values. Canonical-ID ties use lexicographic compact ASCII JSON. Geometry order in the manifest is the declared geometries array; timing job order is hashed.

camera_truths.exact_q: For target a/b and draw i: q=floor(N*a/b)+1 if i modulo b < (N*a modulo b), otherwise floor(N*a/b). The 16 planned q values have exact arithmetic mean N*a/b.
camera_truths.world: First q cells of occupancy_rank are occupied. Selected occupied cells use latent_top_bit (0 bottom,1 top); unselected occupied cells use bottom; all other cells air.
camera_truths.input_domains: Selected cells [air,bottom,top], others [air,bottom]. Do not supply true occupancy, occupied positions, truth labels or reference supports to inference beyond the observations.
camera_truths.pairing: Identical states, domains, cameras and memberships; only top material changes stone to oak. Do not pair by image-family ordinal.
camera_truths.sampling_population: Uniform occupied-position subsets conditional on q, then independent equiprobable slab halves at occupied selected cells; this is not uniform over all legal worlds.
camera_truths.repeated_inputs: Retain every draw/recipe timing slot. Oracle/factor caches may reuse immutable data, never another draw's timings. Report unique signatures and multiplicities.

cameras.intrinsics: width=height=R; fx=fy=3*R/2; cx=cy=R/2; existing half-pixel rational rays
cameras.duplicate_resolution_rule: If actual R and all other slot keys coincide, execute once and attach all regime memberships. No other timing-slot deduplication.
cameras.factor_order: For clean inputs, unique ordered A2RayCell vectors sorted lexicographically by (cell,bottom_hit,top_hit), independent of labels/palette; retain complete pixel-to-factor mapping and raw observations. Identical steps must have consistent clean labels.

robustness.selection: Each geometry/k/mask-recipe/density, draw 0, nominal_density, axis_1 and axis_6, both palettes; two extra slots per selected base.
robustness.restriction: Choose floor(N/2) cells with lowest H('restriction_cell',geometry_id,cell). For each, list nonempty subsets of its original domain containing the truth state in increasing bitmask order and select index H('restriction_domain',geometry_id,k,recipe,density_id,cell) modulo list length. Share domains across palette/view/resolution; no-op restrictions remain, never resample.
robustness.contradictory_duplicate: Select first nonempty clean factor in canonical geometric order. Append a copy with target oak if original background, otherwise background. Keep the original. If no nonempty ray exists, generation fails rather than replacing the slot. This is proof-known UNSAT and never introduces stone into oak-only observations.

structured.edge_factor: For edge a<b append bottom-only ray [(a,true,false),(b,true,false)] target oak, then top-only ray [(a,false,true),(b,false,true)] target material(top,palette). This imposes opposite slab halves jointly.
structured.fixed_region: Domains [air,bottom]; one factor listing its cells ascending, each (bottom_hit=true,top_hit=true), target oak. At least one region cell is occupied; occupancy is not fixed to that of graph cases.

recipes.expected: SAT; two orientations; all vertices occupied
SAT; two orientations; all vertices occupied
UNSAT; connected odd cycle; no truth occupancy assigned
SAT; N/2 disjoint components, two orientations each; all vertices occupied
SAT; two components, two orientations each; all vertices occupied
UNSAT; a satisfiable path separate from odd cycle; no truth occupancy assigned
SAT; shape path and separate fixed-hit region

recipes.additional_factor: unary bottom-only ray at vertex 0, target oak; initial domains unchanged
recipes.expected: SAT; unique orientation; all vertices occupied

structured.permutation_rule: Map original vertex i to the ith element of [0..N-1], its reverse, or vertices sorted by H('structured_vertex',N,hash_index,cell). For permuted rays preserve the original step order; do not sort endpoints after relabeling.
structured.canonical_order: Base undirected edges sorted by original endpoint tuple, lower ray then upper ray, followed by fixed-region factor then unary anchor if present. Apply vertex permutation without changing this order.
structured.hashed_factor_order: Sort original factor ordinals by H('structured_factor',N,recipe,permutation_id,factor_ordinal); ties ordinal. Share across palettes.
structured.initial_k: Record count of input domains containing both bottom and top, separate from N and root surviving shape variables; do not pool fixed and graph populations.
structured.legacy_physical_anchors: Unchanged test::a2_fixture(false/true,palette), two palettes, N=8, four extra slots, no camera-suite/resolution memberships. Preserve raw physical rays and active cell IDs.

execution.volume_order: Ascending N; legacy physical anchors first, then declared camera/structured slots at each N. Complete all five epochs of a volume before the next, unless a predeclared stop pauses the study.
execution.workers: Fresh process per epoch/geometry/actual-R/suite/category job; structured jobs use N/recipe/category. Include both palettes and all modes in each job. One pinned CPU, serial workers, no oracle corpus in inference worker.
execution.job_order: Within volume/epoch, sort jobs by H('job_order',epoch,canonical_job_id).
execution.case_order: Within job, sort palette-independent slot IDs by H('case_order',epoch,slot_id). Let j be this zero-based order index.
execution.palette_order: split,same if H('palette_order',epoch,slot_id) modulo 2 is zero, otherwise same,split.
execution.mode_order: Rotate [search,decomposition,fixed_hit,both] left by (j+epoch) modulo 4; same mode order for both palettes of the slot.
execution.api_order: feasibility,projection if (j+epoch) even, otherwise projection,feasibility; selected direct queries follow, ordered cell then air,bottom,top. Fresh initial domains/stats per call; no reuse of inferred domains or witnesses between APIs/configurations.
execution.timing: steady_clock around the API plus budget/diagnostic observation and post-return deadline check. Setup/render/reference/audit/root-GAC/I/O outside timer and costed separately. Keep all epochs and outliers.
execution.resume: Bind protocol, input, executable and environment hashes. Preserve interrupted/invalid records and missing slots. No automatic timing reruns or replacements; a reviewed amendment documents any recovery.

queries.other_selection: Every robustness, structured and physical-anchor slot
queries.literals: All three states at the two deterministically selected cells; six literal calls per selected slot/mode/epoch, including states excluded by initial domains.
queries.pairing: Cell selection excludes palette, configuration, epoch and factor order. For camera slots use geometry_id; for structured use tuple (N,recipe,permutation); for anchors use fixture name.

references.small: Every selected input N<=8: enumerate all domain-legal worlds, not just the true occupancy slice; independent feasibility, exact supports and family size. Caches may reuse identical reference problems, not timings.
references.intermediate_camera_selection: For each N=10/12 geometry, every k and density target: endpoint recipe at k=0,N, compact otherwise; draw 0; nominal_density. Use axis_1 for low, axis_6 for half, oblique_2 for high. Both palettes: 12 pairs per geometry. Additionally the restricted pair at k=N/2, compact, half, draw 0, nominal_density, axis_6. Selection fixed before outcomes.
references.structured: Independent bipartiteness/orientation enumeration per component, exact fixed-region binary first-hit supports, and scalar first-hit witness validation for every structured case. Brute-force every N<=8 instance and identity/canonical instances of every recipe/palette at N=10/12. Verify predicted supports as well as status.
references.camera_renderer: Independent exact primitive-AABB intersections from serialized raw rays; a new adapter may call unchanged frozen phase_a.reference_ray. Explicitly translate material names/codes. Compare every generating truth with both existing C++ render paths; no solver outcome feeds generation.
references.all_returned_witnesses: Check original input domains and original rays/factors independently of propagation/search. Projection witness union must equal returned supports, but this alone cannot prove omitted literals unsupported.
references.cross_configuration: Compare every resolved answer/support mask; UNRESOLVED versus resolved is not a contradiction. Agreement is not independent proof.
references.uncovered_negatives: Mark unsupported literals and UNSAT claims without exact external references as solver-certified only. Camera truth witnesses certify SAT ground truth but do not certify complete projection.
references.audit_exhaustion: Pause; never silently discard mandatory checks or mark them passed.

measurements.root_diagnostics: One untimed GAC/root-residual diagnostic per design slot in a separate preprocessing process after the input manifest is frozen; save components, sizes, variables, shape variables, factors and root consistency. Do not supply propagated domains to measured calls.
measurements.ambiguity: Supported literals and singleton status from complete projection; independent family size/ambiguity when an exact reference exists. Unknown remains unknown. Structured analytic counts remain a separate population.
measurements.first_witness: Standalone feasibility work/time versus full projection work/time and query counts; no claimed exact internal phase split or subtraction of separate timings.
measurements.memory: Inference-worker peak RSS/input bytes by job, with external 4 GiB guard; no solver-only allocation claim and no oracle memory in inference worker.

budgets.exhaustion: UNRESOLVED with reason node/time/watchdog/memory; never UNSAT. Projection budget covers all internal work. Post-return deadline check rejects late completion. Aborting attempted node can yield 1000001 entries; killed counters stay null if unavailable.
budgets.technical_errors: Separate invalid-run flags and immediate integrity pause; not scientific UNSAT or an ordinary budget outcome.
budgets.administrative_stop: Stop scheduling when the cap is met, after the current call closes or watchdog fires. Keep all unfinished manifest slots as unattempted; never count them as solver UNRESOLVED. No budget escalation or result-dependent subset replacement.

analysis.primary_population: Equal truth-draw weights within geometry/k/mask-recipe/density/actual-resolution/suite/palette, then equal recipe weights at fixed other factors. Preserve multiplicities. Headline volume comparison: half occupancy, nominal_density; other factor levels separate.
analysis.family_sensitivity: Within identical mask/domain/design stratum and palette, group equal complete image signatures, average their draw measurements, then equal weight observed families. This is observed-family weighting only, not an estimate of the full family population. Collapse equal recipe masks for this auxiliary summary and disclose the mapping.
analysis.runtime_summary: Per-slot median of five completed epochs; nearest-rank weighted median/p95, mean, maximum, all epoch values, between-epoch variation, and largest individual trial. Incomplete slots excluded only from explicitly labeled resolved-only timing summaries, never from outcome/coverage denominators.
analysis.censoring: Retain exhaustion bounds and reasons; no zero or completed-60-second imputation. Show resolved fraction and reference coverage alongside work/time distributions. No readiness pass where needed percentiles or coverage are censored/unknown.
analysis.comparisons: Paired truth/draw contrasts for palette, k, visibility and resolution; separate geometry roles and SAT/UNSAT classes. No grand mean across all volumes or control categories, no causal ranking of measured residual/ambiguity bins, no exponential-fit claim.
analysis.old_dataset: Read-only historical anchor with its original truth/family weights and reconstructed identity; never merge old timings into new epochs.

decision_rules.status: Prospective engineering policies, not decisions already reached
decision_rules.operating_cohort: Primary ladder geometry, half occupancy, k=N/2 or N, axis_2 or axis_3, nominal_density, both configuration. Evaluate each N/k/suite/palette separately, pooling recipes equally and their 16 draws equally.
decision_rules.rate: A design slot is unresolved if any of its scheduled epochs exhausts. Denominator all slots in the stratum; readiness requires complete scheduled coverage. First-epoch screening uses that epoch only and is labeled preliminary.
decision_rules.api_scope: Quantitative work/time/rate warning thresholds apply to feasibility and projection separately. Sampled queries are reported separately; any unresolved sampled query in an operating cohort prevents a readiness pass. Maximum-node readiness includes those sampled calls.
decision_rules.integrity_stop: Any invalid witness, exact-reference mismatch, contradictory resolved configuration outputs or completed-repeat integer-work mismatch pauses the whole study.

architecture_review.growth_matching: ladder12 versus ladder08 at the same k fraction, occupancy target, suite, palette, nominal_density and API; never mix fixed k=2 with fractional k. Runtime denominators use positive recorded nanoseconds; report any censoring instead of inventing a ratio.

memory_review.matching: Same camera suite, nominal_density regime and worker category; compare the maximum peak across corresponding epochs of ladder12 versus ladder08. Worker contains both palettes/all k and densities for that job, so this is a worker-level resource comparison, not a per-case solver-memory statistic.

decision_rules.timing_of_review: After a whole first epoch at each N, unresolved/absolute-node/absolute-time/absolute-memory triggers pause all remaining epochs and volumes, not just difficult cases. All growth ratios and final readiness require five epochs. Administrative/integrity caps apply immediately.
decision_rules.sample_scope: Sixteen truth draws per recipe support finite-design screening, not precise population failure-rate estimates. Zero observed failures does not exclude rare difficult worlds.
decision_rules.candidate_camera_recovery_readiness: At both 10 and 12: complete mandatory audits and operating cohorts, zero unresolved including their sampled queries, p95 feasibility<=0.1s, p95 projection<=1s, maximum nodes<100000, worker peak<=512MiB, no growth flags; all declared structured cases resolved and verified with both. Only supports considering a bounded camera/lattice-recovery prototype at a separate checkpoint, not general large-scene readiness.
decision_rules.grey_zone: Neither automatic expansion nor rejection; publish complete evidence and review before new work.
decision_rules.stress_only_failure: Weak-view or abstract-stress failures are reported separately and restrict claims; do not conflate them with the operating-cohort rate. Resource/integrity caps can still pause the full collection.

planned_counts.interpretation: Design/timing slots including repeated draw or mask-recipe inputs; not measured results or guaranteed distinct cases. Shared actual resolutions are counted once.
planned_counts.cost_scenarios: At 1/10/100 ms average per timed call: approximately 0.9/9/90 solver-hours, plus preparation/audits/process overhead. This arithmetic is not a benchmark prediction; 48-hour scheduling cap governs incomplete collection.

publication.before_any_solver_including_gac: Implement/review the collector and independent references; validate guards at a separately authorized implementation checkpoint; freeze source/executable/compiler/host identities and commit a complete deterministic input manifest with exact rays/factors/domains/truth IDs, membership mappings and hashes before evaluating those inputs.
artifacts: all attempted raw calls and missing slots
publication.amendment_rule: Any population, budget, heuristic, reference-coverage or analysis change requires a new version published before affected collection, disclosing all already observed results. Never overwrite v1 to hide drift.
open_preflight_items: Implement generic collector and independent reference adapter without changing accepted source
Record and verify available CPU/compiler/OS watchdog and memory enforcement before timing; failure blocks start rather than weakening controls
Confirm mandatory reference work fits administrative cap; exhaustion pauses without dropping audits
publication.this_checkpoint_runs: No solver, benchmark, case generator, reference enumeration, correctness gate, sanitizer or camera recovery. Only source inspection, protocol writing and static protocol checks.
